learning_outcomes.text: Understand the fundamentals of the operation of energy transformation systems from alternative and/or renewable sources.
Be able to solve problems that an Engineer usually faces in the exercise of their profession.
Understanding and interpretation of texts and data, development of skills for their specification and their clear and concise exposition.
Aptitude for the distribution of resources and time and their implementation in real situations.
Ability to transmit concepts, ideas, processes, etc., related to Industrial Engineering orally and in writing, clearly and correctly.
Ability for teamwork and capacity for the development of multidisciplinary projects.
Ability to relate to other people and an open attitude towards creating new relationships.
Ability to incorporate new knowledge in the area of Industrial Engineering, based on the acquired training and necessary for the evolution of technique.

assessment_rules: Student learning will be assessed based on continuous activities and partial knowledge tests. The final grade can be obtained through continuous assessment, without needing a first-call exam. If continuous assessment is failed, students must take a final written exam covering all content from the partial tests. To pass the course, it is essential to obtain at least a 4 out of 10 in either the partial tests or the final written exam for averaging.
